task: Build a 2D ESL telling-time game: 12 placeholder scenes with dynamically rendered SVG analog clocks, hold-to-talk speech recognition, and grammar-aware time-answer matching. Vanilla ES modules, no build step. Full frozen spec in SPEC.md.

slices.task: Decide the level pools, the accepted/rejected time-expression grammar, the alternatives policy, the scene/voice/layer architecture, and the unsupported-browser fallback. Written to SPEC.md.

Implement src/time-match.js exactly to SPEC.md sections 3.1-3.5 (normalisation of numeral-form STT output, ordered-token structure parsing, o'clock grammar rule, past/to forms, spoken-form generation) plus src/time-match.test.mjs, a plain-node assertion table covering every row of the accepted and rejected structure tables and the level-4 five-minute times.

Implement the rest of the game against the frozen time-match API: index.html, styles/main.css, src/data/times.js, src/data/scenes.js, src/clock.js (SVG analog renderer with fractional hour hand, dispatched via a clock-type registry), src/scheduler.js, src/progress.js, src/speech.js (press-and-hold with pointer capture, keyboard hold, 5s timeout, 300ms tap floor, typed-answer fallback), src/audio.js, src/game.js, src/main.js.
